highlights.title: Afghanistan women defy Taliban ban to pursue their ambitions in secret
highlights.summary: Afghan women risk their lives to pursue their dreams, despite strict Taliban restrictions.

highlights.title: Powering towns on pig manure: How Denmark has transformed energy generation
highlights.summary: Pigs are big business in Denmark. Now their waste is being turned into biogas, which powers the national grid.

highlights.title: Live Updates: Trump’s Whirlwind Asia Trip Starts in the Philippines
highlights.summary: President Trump’s 48-hour trip will begin with a meeting with Southeast Asian leaders in Manila. He will later meet Xi Jinping of China and Vladimir Putin of Russia in Shenzhen, a Chinese economic hub.

highlights.title: Carney and Xi Announce Canada-China Trade Pact
highlights.summary: The agreement between Canada and China and the cordial relations on display by their leaders contrast with the current Canada-U.S. relationship.
